challenges.description: Learn words in a language no one on your team knows from 3 strangers
requirements: Language must be new to all team members

challenges.title: Take a skyline picture
challenges.description: Take a skyline picture, best one gets bonus points

challenges.title: Draw a skyline picture
challenges.description: Draw a skyline picture and post it in the group. If your team knows where it is, you get a bonus point. Team with most correct guesses gets extra bonus points

bonusPoints.criteria: Team guesses correctly: 2 points. Most correct guesses overall: TBD

challenges.title: Try three different NY slices from 3 different locations
challenges.description: Get pizza slices from 3 different locations. Team that gets furthest distance as crow flies between slices gets bonus points (sum each distance)

bonusPoints.criteria: Furthest total distance between all 3 locations

requirements: Photo of each slice with location

challenges.title: Win a game of chess at a park
challenges.description: Win a game of chess at a park (can bring your own chess, play on your phone, or play against someone real)

challenges.title: University campus quiz challenge
challenges.description: Go to a university campus and pass a test. Everyone take a random quiz on sporcle.com. If a majority (or exactly half) of your team passes, get 2x points

bonusPoints.criteria: Majority or half of team passes

requirements: Must be on a university campus

challenges.title: Take a picture with a camera from B&H
challenges.description: Take a picture with a camera from B&H. Best pictures will get bonus points
requirements: Must use a camera from B&H store
Photo must be taken with that camera

challenges.title: Give gifts to 3 people you meet in the city

challenges.title: Sing Empire State of Mind in the 'least New York place'
challenges.description: Sing Empire State of Mind in the least NYC-like place. Bonus points for each member that sings together. Bonus for winner. Bonus for how 'least NYC' it is. No video no points!

bonusPoints.criteria: +1 for each member singing, +3 for least NYC location

requirements: Must sing Empire State of Mind
Location must be justified as 'least NYC'
